audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer had all seven phases as flat 'Skill' while packet chart and content win[] both give Mel every stage except level 6 (Twisted Fate).
audit.why: Grounded: TF is dash-less and block-less so Solar Snare lands freely pre-6; Destiny plus Gate at 6 is his roam/pick window; Mel's item spikes and reflect re-take it after. Packet defect (6/7 Mel vs 47.89%) is explained by his map-wide roam value costing games outside lane — content prose already frames it that way.
audit.corrected: Full chart flipped to the content/packet pattern atomically with rewritten whys and ratings; win[N] already agrees so sides ride alone per the chart rule.

audit.why: Spikes intact: lvl 3-5 snare band, 6 Destiny roam window, first-item reassert, late execute — all present in content spikes[].

audit.whatIsWrong: Two copy-paste-bleed bullets, no digit in breakdown.cooldowns, and the auto-reset burst tell (Pick a Card is an attack reset — the wind-up, not the cast, is the cue) was absent.
audit.why: Kit: Pick a Card 6s flat, hardCC gold card, autoReset flag; Wild Cards 6-5s projectile Rebuttal returns; Destiny 170/140/110s. Mel W reflects Wild Cards; the gold card is an empowered attack, so the reflect's damage-prevention window is what answers it, not a projectile return.
audit.corrected: Bleed bullets replaced with title-matching bodies; cooldowns field carries 6s W / 6-5s Q / 170s R / 38s Rebuttal and the auto-reset wind-up tell.

edits.before: Q-volley his last-hits — the radiant barrage chips from a range most mids can't answer at one.
edits.after: TF has only a weak auto and dodgeable Wild Cards at one — your Q plus passive out-trade him.

edits.before: W online: Rebuttal turns his poke into YOUR poke. The reflect re-prices every projectile in the lane.
edits.after: Your volley poke and range exceed his single-target early damage — level 2 stays yours; keep chipping.

edits.before: E completes the kit: the snare into full volley is your kill pattern. Hold it for real windows.
edits.after: Solar Snare lands freely on a dash-less TF — every root converts into a Q chunk. Trade on cooldown.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — volley every wave contact and bank the overwhelm stacks on his health bar.
edits.after: Through 4-5 he still can't dodge your E and has no punish for your poke — keep banking the stacks.

edits.before: Golden Eclipse online — the execute threshold turns your chip war into a countdown he can see.
edits.after: Destiny plus Gate and the gold card make roam-and-pick threats you can't match — ward and follow.

edits.before: Luden's spike: snare-volley chunks half bars and the execute cleans the remainder. Force contacts.
edits.after: First item: Q waveclear plus a Rebuttal held for the gold card neutralize his only reliable pick tool.

edits.before: Late Mel is a counter-artillery battery: reflect their poke, snare their dive, and execute the chipped.
edits.after: Two items in, Eclipse executes an escape-less TF and Rebuttal reflects Wild Cards — fights are yours.

edits.before: - Twisted Fate Pick a Card (Gold): matchup-defining — The locked gold card starts every trade and gank — back off the moment it glows yellow. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Rebuttal for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Pick a Card is a 6s cooldown and an auto-attack reset: the wind-up after the yellow lock is your cue to step back, not the cast. - Wild Cards runs 6s down to 5s. - Destiny is 170s at rank 1 — its downtime is your roam-free window. Budget your 38s Rebuttal for the gold card.

edits.before: Q-volley the last-hit, bank the overwhelm stacks, and keep W glowing — the chip is free while his best spells are hostages.
edits.after: TF has no dash and no block — thread Solar Snare on his step-up and every root converts into a full Q chunk for free.

edits.before: Burning Rebuttal on chip and then eating the full rotation it existed to return — the reflect is the matchup; spend it like a verdict.
edits.after: The snare is your kill pattern and your gank insurance — spent on spacing, a gold-card gank has no answer left. Hold it for windows.

notes: Full-layer chart flipped from flat Skill to the content/packet pattern (Mel everywhere except Twisted Fate at level 6); win[N] already agreed so sides ride alone. Left diff=EVEN 5.5/10: 47.89% with a lane Mel mostly wins reads as roam-tax, consistent with content framing. Content wants.you[1] says Rebuttal 'eats' the gold card — the gold card is an empowered attack, not a clean projectile; Rebuttal's damage-prevention likely still answers it but the reflect-back is unverified, so I did not add new reflect claims about it (listed as unverified).
